bildnachweis.metaTitel: Image credits and licenses | Tarot Cup
bildnachweis.metaBeschreibung: Where the 1909 card images in Tarot Cup and on this website come from, and under which license the website fonts are published.
bildnachweis.vorspann: Here you can find out where the card images come from and which fonts this website uses.

absaetze: The card images in the app and on this website were drawn by Pamela Colman Smith. They were published in 1909 and are in the public domain.

They are based on scans of the original print from Wikimedia Commons. In the app, the images are only cropped to the picture area. For this website, they have been reduced in size, cropped to a uniform format of 480 × 822 pixels, and saved as WebP. Otherwise they are unchanged.
The website uses two fonts: Cormorant Garamond by Christian Thalmann and Inter by Rasmus Andersson. Both are under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.
The font files are hosted directly on this website and are not loaded from external servers.
